name: code-review-quality
author: Seth Hobson

license.scope: Complete clean root licence at the same immutable commit as this package.
obligations: Retain original copyright/attribution and license text.

assignments.essential_function: Review a pull request for correctness, security, performance, test quality and maintainability, then give prioritized, constructive feedback.

review: Begins with business/PR context and CI, progresses through architecture and code, separates blocking defects from suggestions, and checks behavioral tests and common language mistakes. Templates support actionable review.
essential_function: Review a pull request for correctness, security, performance, test quality and maintainability, then give prioritized, constructive feedback.
native_prerequisites: Diff, surrounding code, requirement and test/CI evidence; repository access appropriate to the review.

dependency_decisions: Preserve original guidance and all branches; apply only the counted local-path edits, standard header metadata/name, and prominent packaging modification notice.

Preserve slash-command identifiers and $ARGUMENTS examples; changing the installed name does not create native command dispatch. Ordinary direct invocation with supplied task context remains possible where authored.
Record the upstream revision, Git blob SHA-1, SHA-256 and original bytes in provenance; generated ATTRIBUTION.md is curator packaging documentation, not upstream-authored advice.
The full primary contains its required guidance and examples; it names no required local supporting file or sibling skill. Do not add unrelated repository content.

research_pin_note: The installed source pin remains explicit above; already clean licensed packages may retain their earlier reviewed pin rather than mix historical support files.
source_review_limitations: A checklist and examples do not prove absence of vulnerabilities or regressions.
Original source includes approve/comment/request-changes as review outcomes; use only the authority supplied by the adopting workflow.
source_review_limitations_scope: Original-source research observations retained verbatim. Statements about unchanged instructions or upstream folder layout describe the reviewed originals; this package applies only the recorded metadata/name/path adaptations. Current packaging decisions and runtime requirements are recorded separately.
